conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a reasonable growth outlook.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It utilizes and adds to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this approach significantly increases both upside potential and drawdown risk, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero, eliminating all leveraged ETFs.
Sell SMH and CRWD to zero, reducing high-beta sector and single-name exposure.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30%, to prioritize steady monthly distributions.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It rotates into income-generating ETFs and broad index funds, cutting high-beta and leveraged positions. While prioritizing low drawdown and reliable income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in market selloffs. This is not a savings account.
